#sim cell number
```{r}
# cell-number benchmark by stratified downsampling from 20k 6-timepoint master data

rm(list = ls()); gc()

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(qs)
  library(Seurat)
  library(Matrix)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(readr)
})

# Step 0. IO

master_out_dir <- "/Users/zhangqian/scRhythmBayes/data/Benchmark/benchmark_timepoint_number_4000g_20000c"
out_dir <- "/Users/zhangqian/scRhythmBayes/data/Benchmark/benchmark_cell_number_4000g_6tp"

master_obj_file <- file.path(
  master_out_dir,
  "sim_objects",
  "simulate_data_timepoint6_4000g_20000c.rds"
)

master_truth_file <- file.path(
  master_out_dir,
  "truth_params",
  "truth_params_timepoint6_4000g_20000c.rds"
)

obj_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "sim_objects")
truth_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "truth_params")
index_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "index")

dir.create(obj_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(truth_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(index_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

target_cell_vec <- c(10500, 6000, 3000, 1500, 600)
ZT_points <- c(0, 4, 8, 12, 16, 20)

# Step 1. Helper functions

wrap24 <- function(x) {
  ((x %% 24) + 24) %% 24
}

circ_diff_h <- function(x, center) {
  ((as.numeric(x) - as.numeric(center) + 12) %% 24) - 12
}

make_cell_design <- function(target_cell_vec, n_condition = 2, n_timepoint = 6) {
  stopifnot(all(target_cell_vec %% (n_condition * n_timepoint) == 0))

  tibble(
    target_n_cell = target_cell_vec,
    actual_n_cell = target_cell_vec,
    n_per_condition_per_ZT = target_cell_vec / (n_condition * n_timepoint),
    n_cond_1 = actual_n_cell / 2,
    n_cond_2 = actual_n_cell / 2
  )
}

make_quantile_bin <- function(x, n_bin = 6) {
  x <- as.numeric(x)
  rk <- rank(x, ties.method = "random")

  brks <- quantile(
    rk,
    probs = seq(0, 1, length.out = n_bin + 1),
    na.rm = TRUE,
    names = FALSE
  )

  brks <- unique(brks)

  if (length(brks) <= 2) {
    return(rep(1L, length(x)))
  }

  as.integer(cut(
    rk,
    breaks = brks,
    include.lowest = TRUE,
    labels = FALSE
  ))
}

sample_stratified_phase <- function(metadata, n_per_condition_per_ZT, n_bin = 6, seed = 2026) {
  set.seed(seed)

  meta_i <- metadata %>%
    mutate(
      cell = as.character(cell),
      condition = as.character(condition),
      ZT_sym = as.numeric(ZT_sym),
      ZT_true = as.numeric(ZT_true),
      zt_offset_h = circ_diff_h(ZT_true, ZT_sym)
    ) %>%
    group_by(condition, ZT_sym) %>%
    mutate(zt_offset_bin = make_quantile_bin(zt_offset_h, n_bin = n_bin)) %>%
    ungroup()

  sampled_cells <- meta_i %>%
    group_by(condition, ZT_sym) %>%
    group_modify(function(.x, .y) {
      n_need <- n_per_condition_per_ZT
      stopifnot(nrow(.x) >= n_need)

      bin_tab <- .x %>%
        count(zt_offset_bin, name = "n_bin") %>%
        mutate(
          prop_bin = n_bin / sum(n_bin),
          n_draw_raw = prop_bin * n_need,
          n_draw = floor(n_draw_raw),
          remainder = n_draw_raw - n_draw
        ) %>%
        arrange(desc(remainder), zt_offset_bin)

      remain_n <- n_need - sum(bin_tab$n_draw)

      if (remain_n > 0) {
        bin_tab$n_draw[seq_len(remain_n)] <- bin_tab$n_draw[seq_len(remain_n)] + 1
      }

      out_list <- vector("list", nrow(bin_tab))

      for (j in seq_len(nrow(bin_tab))) {
        bin_j <- bin_tab$zt_offset_bin[j]
        n_draw_j <- bin_tab$n_draw[j]

        pool_j <- .x %>%
          filter(zt_offset_bin == bin_j)

        n_draw_j <- min(n_draw_j, nrow(pool_j))

        out_list[[j]] <- pool_j[
          sample(seq_len(nrow(pool_j)), size = n_draw_j, replace = FALSE),
          ,
          drop = FALSE
        ]
      }

      out <- bind_rows(out_list)

      if (nrow(out) > n_need) {
        out <- out[
          sample(seq_len(nrow(out)), size = n_need, replace = FALSE),
          ,
          drop = FALSE
        ]
      }

      if (nrow(out) < n_need) {
        pool_add <- .x %>%
          filter(!(cell %in% out$cell))

        add_n <- n_need - nrow(out)

        add_cells <- pool_add[
          sample(seq_len(nrow(pool_add)), size = add_n, replace = FALSE),
          ,
          drop = FALSE
        ]

        out <- bind_rows(out, add_cells)
      }

      out
    }) %>%
    ungroup()

  sampled_cells$cell
}

check_downsample_distribution <- function(metadata, target_n_cell, actual_n_cell, n_per_condition_per_ZT) {
  diag_zt <- metadata %>%
    count(condition, ZT_sym, name = "n_cell") %>%
    arrange(condition, ZT_sym)

  diag_offset <- metadata %>%
    mutate(
      zt_offset_h = circ_diff_h(ZT_true, ZT_sym),
      abs_zt_offset_h = abs(zt_offset_h)
    ) %>%
    group_by(condition, ZT_sym) %>%
    summarise(
      n_cell = n(),
      mean_offset_h = mean(zt_offset_h),
      sd_offset_h = sd(zt_offset_h),
      median_offset_h = median(zt_offset_h),
      median_abs_offset_h = median(abs_zt_offset_h),
      q05_offset_h = quantile(zt_offset_h, 0.05),
      q25_offset_h = quantile(zt_offset_h, 0.25),
      q75_offset_h = quantile(zt_offset_h, 0.75),
      q95_offset_h = quantile(zt_offset_h, 0.95),
      pct_within_0.5h = mean(abs_zt_offset_h <= 0.5) * 100,
      pct_within_1h = mean(abs_zt_offset_h <= 1) * 100,
      pct_within_2h = mean(abs_zt_offset_h <= 2) * 100,
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  diag_overall <- metadata %>%
    mutate(
      zt_offset_h = circ_diff_h(ZT_true, ZT_sym),
      abs_zt_offset_h = abs(zt_offset_h)
    ) %>%
    summarise(
      target_n_cell = target_n_cell,
      actual_n_cell = actual_n_cell,
      n_per_condition_per_ZT = n_per_condition_per_ZT,
      n_cell = n(),
      n_condition = n_distinct(condition),
      n_ZT = n_distinct(ZT_sym),
      n_celltype = n_distinct(celltype),
      mean_offset_h = mean(zt_offset_h),
      sd_offset_h = sd(zt_offset_h),
      median_offset_h = median(zt_offset_h),
      median_abs_offset_h = median(abs_zt_offset_h),
      pct_within_0.5h = mean(abs_zt_offset_h <= 0.5) * 100,
      pct_within_1h = mean(abs_zt_offset_h <= 1) * 100,
      pct_within_2h = mean(abs_zt_offset_h <= 2) * 100
    )

  list(
    diag_zt = diag_zt,
    diag_offset = diag_offset,
    diag_overall = diag_overall
  )
}

# Step 2. Load master 20k object and truth

obj_master <- readRDS(master_obj_file)
truth_master <- readRDS(master_truth_file)

DefaultAssay(obj_master) <- "RNA"

count_master <- Seurat::GetAssayData(
  obj_master,
  assay = "RNA",
  slot = "counts"
)

metadata_master <- obj_master@meta.data %>%
  as.data.frame()

metadata_master$cell <- rownames(metadata_master)

stopifnot(
  nrow(count_master) == 4000,
  ncol(count_master) == 20000,
  identical(colnames(count_master), metadata_master$cell),
  all(c("condition", "group", "celltype", "ZT_sym", "ZT_true", "theta_true") %in% colnames(metadata_master)),
  identical(sort(unique(as.numeric(metadata_master$ZT_sym))), ZT_points),
  length(unique(metadata_master$condition)) == 2,
  all(sort(unique(as.character(metadata_master$condition))) == c("cond_1", "cond_2")),
  length(unique(metadata_master$celltype)) == 1,
  all(unique(metadata_master$celltype) == "Celltype1")
)

cell_design <- make_cell_design(target_cell_vec)
print(cell_design)

write_csv(cell_design, file.path(index_dir, "cell_number_design.csv"))
saveRDS(cell_design, file.path(index_dir, "cell_number_design.rds"))

master_diag <- check_downsample_distribution(
  metadata = metadata_master,
  target_n_cell = 20000,
  actual_n_cell = 20000,
  n_per_condition_per_ZT = NA_real_
)

write_csv(
  master_diag$diag_overall,
  file.path(index_dir, "master_20k_ZT_true_distribution_overall.csv")
)

write_csv(
  master_diag$diag_offset,
  file.path(index_dir, "master_20k_ZT_true_offset_by_condition_ZT.csv")
)

# Step 3. Generate downsampled objects

record_all <- list()
diag_overall_all <- list()
diag_zt_all <- list()
diag_offset_all <- list()

for (i in seq_len(nrow(cell_design))) {
  target_n_cell <- cell_design$target_n_cell[i]
  actual_n_cell <- cell_design$actual_n_cell[i]
  n_per_condition_per_ZT <- cell_design$n_per_condition_per_ZT[i]

  message("============================================================")
  message("Downsampling target_n_cell = ", target_n_cell)
  message("actual_n_cell = ", actual_n_cell)
  message("n_per_condition_per_ZT = ", n_per_condition_per_ZT)

  keep_cell <- sample_stratified_phase(
    metadata = metadata_master,
    n_per_condition_per_ZT = n_per_condition_per_ZT,
    n_bin = 6,
    seed = 2026 + target_n_cell
  )

  keep_cell <- as.character(keep_cell)

  count_i <- count_master[, keep_cell, drop = FALSE]

  metadata_i <- metadata_master[
    match(keep_cell, metadata_master$cell),
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  stopifnot(
    identical(colnames(count_i), metadata_i$cell),
    nrow(count_i) == 4000,
    ncol(count_i) == actual_n_cell,
    all(table(metadata_i$condition, metadata_i$ZT_sym) == n_per_condition_per_ZT),
    length(unique(metadata_i$condition)) == 2,
    length(unique(metadata_i$celltype)) == 1,
    all(unique(metadata_i$celltype) == "Celltype1"),
    identical(sort(unique(as.numeric(metadata_i$ZT_sym))), ZT_points)
  )

  rownames(metadata_i) <- metadata_i$cell

  obj_i <- CreateSeuratObject(
    counts = count_i,
    meta.data = metadata_i
  )

  DefaultAssay(obj_i) <- "RNA"

  truth_i <- truth_master

  truth_i$benchmark <- list(
    benchmark = "cell_number",
    target_n_cell = target_n_cell,
    actual_n_cell = actual_n_cell,
    n_per_condition_per_ZT = n_per_condition_per_ZT,
    ZT_points = ZT_points,
    n_timepoint = length(ZT_points),
    n_gene = nrow(count_i),
    n_cell = ncol(count_i),
    n_condition = 2,
    n_celltype = 1,
    truth_source = "stratified_downsampling_from_20k_6tp_master_by_condition_ZT_and_ZTtrue_offset"
  )

  obj_file <- file.path(
    obj_dir,
    paste0("simulate_data_cell", target_n_cell, "_4000g_6tp.rds")
  )

  truth_file <- file.path(
    truth_dir,
    paste0("truth_params_cell", target_n_cell, "_4000g_6tp.rds")
  )

  saveRDS(obj_i, obj_file)
  saveRDS(truth_i, truth_file)

  diag_i <- check_downsample_distribution(
    metadata = metadata_i,
    target_n_cell = target_n_cell,
    actual_n_cell = actual_n_cell,
    n_per_condition_per_ZT = n_per_condition_per_ZT
  )

  diag_overall_all[[as.character(target_n_cell)]] <- diag_i$diag_overall

  diag_zt_all[[as.character(target_n_cell)]] <- diag_i$diag_zt %>%
    mutate(
      target_n_cell = target_n_cell,
      actual_n_cell = actual_n_cell
    )

  diag_offset_all[[as.character(target_n_cell)]] <- diag_i$diag_offset %>%
    mutate(
      target_n_cell = target_n_cell,
      actual_n_cell = actual_n_cell
    )

  print(diag_i$diag_overall)
  print(diag_i$diag_zt)
  print(diag_i$diag_offset)

  record_all[[as.character(target_n_cell)]] <- tibble(
    target_n_cell = target_n_cell,
    actual_n_cell = actual_n_cell,
    n_per_condition_per_ZT = n_per_condition_per_ZT,
    n_gene = nrow(obj_i),
    n_cell = ncol(obj_i),
    n_condition = length(unique(metadata_i$condition)),
    n_celltype = length(unique(metadata_i$celltype)),
    n_timepoint = length(ZT_points),
    ZT_points = paste(ZT_points, collapse = ","),
    obj_file = obj_file,
    truth_file = truth_file,
    n_cond_1 = sum(metadata_i$condition == "cond_1"),
    n_cond_2 = sum(metadata_i$condition == "cond_2"),
    status = "finished_stratified_downsampled"
  )

  rm(obj_i, truth_i, count_i, metadata_i, diag_i)
  gc()
}

# Step 4. Save index and diagnostics

cell_number_index <- bind_rows(record_all) %>%
  arrange(desc(target_n_cell))

diag_overall <- bind_rows(diag_overall_all) %>%
  arrange(desc(target_n_cell))

diag_zt <- bind_rows(diag_zt_all) %>%
  arrange(desc(target_n_cell), condition, ZT_sym)

diag_offset <- bind_rows(diag_offset_all) %>%
  arrange(desc(target_n_cell), condition, ZT_sym)

write_csv(
  cell_number_index,
  file.path(index_dir, "cell_number_sim_object_index.csv")
)

saveRDS(
  cell_number_index,
  file.path(index_dir, "cell_number_sim_object_index.rds")
)

write_csv(
  diag_overall,
  file.path(index_dir, "cell_number_ZT_true_distribution_overall.csv")
)

saveRDS(
  diag_overall,
  file.path(index_dir, "cell_number_ZT_true_distribution_overall.rds")
)

write_csv(
  diag_zt,
  file.path(index_dir, "cell_number_condition_ZT_table.csv")
)

saveRDS(
  diag_zt,
  file.path(index_dir, "cell_number_condition_ZT_table.rds")
)

write_csv(
  diag_offset,
  file.path(index_dir, "cell_number_ZT_true_offset_by_condition_ZT.csv")
)

saveRDS(
  diag_offset,
  file.path(index_dir, "cell_number_ZT_true_offset_by_condition_ZT.rds")
)

print(cell_number_index)
print(diag_overall)

message("Finished generating cell-number benchmark objects by stratified downsampling.")
message("Object output: ", obj_dir)
message("Truth output: ", truth_dir)
message("Index output: ", index_dir)

rm(obj_master, truth_master, count_master, metadata_master)
gc()
```
